name: ACE Medical Inc

about:
ACE Medical Inc was founded in 2001 in Honolulu, Hawaii, as a family-owned and locally operated durable medical equipment provider. The business was established to serve the islands' home healthcare needs and has remained under family ownership since its inception.

The company supplies a broad range of home healthcare equipment, including mobility aids, walking aids, oxygen systems, CPAP and BiPAP machines, bathroom safety equipment, and medical beds. In addition to sales, ACE Medical offers rental options for many of its products, catering to both short-term and long-term needs. The firm serves individual patients as well as healthcare facilities across Hawaii and overseas, drawing on over 25 years of experience in the region.

ACE Medical primarily serves the home healthcare and durable medical equipment sectors. Its customer base includes elderly patients seeking mobility and respiratory support, as well as hospitals, clinics, and long-term care facilities in Hawaii and international markets that require reliable medical supplies. The company emphasizes a community-oriented approach, referring to its customers as 'ohana' (family).

The company differentiates itself through its family-owned, locally rooted model and a senior discount of 5–10% on Tuesdays. It highlights personalized customer service and long-standing local experience as key reasons customers choose ACE Medical over larger national chains.
